title: Proud Parents with Toddler on House Steps, 1940s Family Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-1940s outdoor family snapshot featuring a proud father in a dark suit holding a chubby baby/toddler alongside the mother on the front steps of their home. The mother wears a tailored broad-shouldered jacket typical of World War II-era fashion with her hands tucked casually into her pockets. They are framed by porch architecture featuring Craftsman-style multi-pane windows and lush garden shrubbery. The print has distinct deckled edges common in 1940s consumer photofinishing.
